summary: The staged help site is served on node1 over TCP 8080. Legacy /manual/ URLs permanently redirect to matching /help/ paths while preserving query strings. /status.txt remains directly accessible. The configuration and content survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible nginx 1.28.3 without changing the operating-system release or kernel.
Configured nginx to serve /srv/legacy2/permanent-url-migration on port 8080.
Enabled nginx in the default OpenRC runlevel.
Verified direct help and status responses against staged-file SHA-256 hashes.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot ID changed and the service recovered.

evidence.requirement: Serve the staged help tree on TCP port 8080
evidence.summary: Shows nginx listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 8080, HTTP 200 responses, and response hashes matching the staged help files.

evidence.requirement: Permanently redirect old manual URLs while retaining path and query string
evidence.summary: Shows HTTP 301 responses mapping both /manual/ and nested manual paths to their corresponding /help/ URLs with query strings intact.
Shows HTTP 200 for /status.txt and a response hash identical to the supplied status document.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Pre-change and post-restart evidence shows Alpine Linux v3.23 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts unchanged.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 072ad7d5-7ab7-47f2-98d3-3c0e98f861cc, reboot acknowledgement, new boot ID 4a5ac0d4-f8a7-485a-86b1-0a66fb619799, and recovered enabled nginx service, listener, redirects, help content, and status content.
